description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1767/19 of 19.07.2012, Moratuwa D/S Division and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette exclusively deals with land title registration amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing servitude rights, life interests, mortgages, and other encumbrances on specific parcels of land. The content focuses entirely on land property matters including cadastral maps, land parcels, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3.
